title: Catch async errors with try/catch
why_it_matters: Without it, a failed request leaves the user staring at nothing.
explanation: When an awaited promise rejects, await throws the error at that line, so ordinary try/catch can catch it. Without a catch you get an unhandled rejection and the user sees nothing happen. Always decide what the user should see when a request fails.
try_it: Add a finally block that logs 'done' whether or not it failed.
